_published_faq.name: How do I add Global Database to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Global Database to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.globaldatabase.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Global Database MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Global Database provides these MCP tools: get_company_by_url, get_company_by_linkedin, get_company_financials, get_company_ownership, and autocomplete.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Global Database?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Global Database in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Global Database MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Global Database requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Global Database is developed by Global Database. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
